softwareInnerHero.title: Render Faster, Create Better
paragraphs: Chaos Corona is a versatile and powerful rendering engine that delivers high-quality, photorealistic images for architecture, design, and VFX projects. With an intuitive interface and fast performance, Corona enables artists to bring their creative vision to life with ease.

Designed by artists for artists, it integrates seamlessly with major 3D applications like 3ds Max and Cinema 4D, offering physically-based rendering for realistic materials, lighting, and camera effects.

Whether producing architectural visualizations, product designs, or animated films, Chaos Corona provides advanced tools that ensure efficient workflows, complete creative control, and stunning, professional-quality results.

cardSections.subheading: Discover why artists worldwide choose Chaos Corona

items.title: Lightning-Fast Rendering
items.body: Experience unparalleled speed with Corona’s highly optimized rendering engine. Render complex scenes in minutes instead of hours, accelerating your workflow and productivity.

items.title: Physically-Based Materials
items.body: Create realistic materials with Corona’s advanced material system. Achieve photorealistic results with intuitive controls and a vast library of presets.

items.title: Advanced Lighting
items.body: Bring your scenes to life with Corona’s powerful lighting tools. From natural daylight to complex studio setups, achieve perfect illumination with ease.

items.title: Seamless Integration
items.body: Work within your favorite 3D application with native plugins for 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, and more. No need to switch between applications or learn new interfaces.

items.title: Intuitive Controls
items.body: Focus on creativity, not technical settings. Corona’s user-friendly interface makes advanced rendering accessible to artists of all skill levels.

items.title: Cloud Rendering
items.body: Scale your rendering power with Corona Cloud. Render multiple frames simultaneously and meet tight deadlines without investing in expensive hardware.
